title: General Strix
description: On the distant planet of At Achrann, General Strix was the tribal leader and warlord of the militaristic Troiks. They were the mortal enemy of the Hattans, who would steal their livestock and declare war on them. Their society was predicated on strength and violence and they lived in constant danger. Strix trained his daughter Hayna, like all the children of the Troik, to be a capable warrior.
